text:
Sasha L.: Hey folks — heading to the Lisbon offsite next Tuesday. Any last-minute survival tips? 
Miguel: Bring a Type C adapter and a 6ft USB-C cable. Hotel outlets can be flaky. Also pack a small power strip if you have one. :thumbsup:
Anya K.: Agree on the adapter. Also consider an eSIM (Airalo) instead of hunting for a SIM — saved me a ton of time at the airport. 
Jon P.: If you're doing evening flights, noise-canceling headphones + a neck pillow. Also quick-dry underwear + a sink laundry soap sheet is a traveler's blessing. 
Sasha L.: Good call on eSIM — did anyone try local transport? I'm debating renting a scooter vs transit. 
Miguel: Transit is super easy, get a Viva viagem card at the station, load it, you're done. Scooters are fun but annoying with luggage. 
Leah M.: Pro tip: restaurants close earlier on Sundays; plan dinners ahead. And bring comfy walking shoes — hills are real. 
OffsiteBot: Reminder: Offsite kickoff at 09:00 Monday in the lobby — sign-up for the walking tour here: https://redwood-inference/portal/offsite-signup 
Anya K.: Also bring a reusable water bottle. Lisbon tap water is fine and it'll save queue time. See my quick packing checklist: 
```
- 2x chargers (phone, laptop)
- Type-C adapter + power strip
- eSIM or local SIM option
- Noise-canceling headphones
- Lightweight rain jacket
- Comfy shoes
``` 
Sasha L.: Thanks everyone — super helpful! I'll add these to the shared doc. :raised_hands:
